_comment: EXPLORATION (HIGH sigma): is sigma>3 worth testing? Sweeps vir_mass_spreads = {3,4,5,6,8} x M {50,100,300,500} x S {10,15,20,30}, virialized lattice 300 nodes, Plummer 1 Gpc, 1000p. 80 cells. Overlaps explore_vir_spread at sigma=3,4 for continuity. The sigma=3 corner was chi2~0.51 (M~100/S~10, growth ~3.0); this checks whether an even wider mass function helps or just runs away. Run: python sweep.py --config sweeps/explore_vir_spread_hi.json (or via the launcher with -IncludeSatellites).
